runtime_input.preprocess: PIL RGB; resize directly to 128x128 with BILINEAR; x=(pixel/255-mean)/std
runtime_input.note: The ncnn model interface still accepts normalized float32. It does not accept raw uint8 as-is.

weights.quantizer_details: Encoded in ncnn model by ncnn2int8; generic per-tensor/per-channel scale and zero-point fields are not separately exported by this workflow.

activations.input_layer_quantization: The external model input remains float32 normalized NCHW; internal handling follows the ncnn model/runtime.

calibration.input_generation: Same RGB + PIL BILINEAR 128x128 + normalized CHW definition as the contract

postprocess_candidate.selection: Temperature fit by validation NLL; threshold selected on validation to attain positive recall >= 0.90
postprocess_candidate.warning: Candidate operating point only; requires project-owner acceptance and is not a clinical threshold.

limitations: No inference on PYNQ-Z2 has been run.
No PL/HLS fixed-point conversion has been run.

A separate EQ candidate was generated with an isolated source-patched ncnn 20260526 quantization tool after identifying an upstream EQ input-indexing issue; see CPU_BASELINE_LOCAL_PROGRESS_2026-10-11.md and work_ncnn_fp32/eq_retry/ for patch notes and artifact hashes.
The source delivery identifies its test set as a development evaluation set, not an untouched final test set.
